lines.en: I walk over dry grass.
This pelt of mine is black.
The patch on my back is hard to make out.
I keep low across the grassland.
I circle the scrub once.
The sun heats black fur.

lines.zh: 我跟着地上的一道影子。
lines.en: I follow a shadow on the ground.
I make almost no sound moving.
I head out onto the savanna.
I cross the dry grass leaving no prints.
Steady steps. No hurry.
The tip of my horn is dark.
I lie low in the grass.
Black fur soaks up the heat.
I shift position in the grass.
I listen, still.
The dry grass reaches my waist.
I raise my head out of the grass.
I don't draw much attention.
I arch my back and shake off the dew.
The wind comes in gusts.
The grass shadows are growing longer.
Black-furred Gabumon feels the cold too.
Nothing needs doing.
Black-furred Gabu, in that pelt.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅空气，黑毛上全是露水。
lines.en: I sniff the air; dew covers my black fur.
You can't see me well, can you.
This black coat is useful.

lines.zh: 我站的地方比你想的深。
lines.en: I'm standing deeper in than you think.
Do not put a hand on me.
My horn points forward.
You've got light on you. I don't.
One step closer and I move.
You search. I watch.
These claws aren't friendly.
Keep your distance.
I rarely make a sound.
I know the sound of the wind in this grass.
There's nothing on me for you.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在太阳底下很亮。
lines.en: Your armor is bright in the sun.
One of my horns points at you.
Are you going to move?
A patch of fur came off.
That made me withdraw.
This black pelt is one I took.
The wound hardly shows in black fur.
Both legs still hold me.
I backed into the grass.
That hit my ribs.
I withdraw deeper into the grass.

lines.zh: 我背上的黑毛被这一下打乱了。
lines.en: That blow messed up the black fur on my back.
A white line now marks my black fur.
That dark thing in your hand.
I can smell it.
That won't draw me.
Just set it down.
I don't much eat that.
Is that fish smell?
I prefer what comes from water.
Hold it further away.
Don't put your hand in the grass.
That will spoil in the sun.
I would rather have fish from the water.
Let me look a bit longer.
You hit black fur.
I slipped back without a sound.
Your hand caught my horn tip.
Your knee knocks against my horn.
The black fur on my shoulder brushes you.
My feet are planted in the dirt.
You slipped stepping back.
There's my fresh print on the ground.
What you hit was only a mass of fur.
That did no harm.
It happens deep in the grass.
Our coats are hard to tell apart.
Do not stare; the grass is deep.
It's darker than I am.

lines.zh: 我们在草里靠了一会儿。
lines.en: We leaned together in the grass.
We flattened the dry grass.
Afterwards, east and west.
There'll be more on the savanna.

lines.zh: 黑毛贴着黑毛，都没出声。
lines.en: Black fur against black fur, neither made a sound.
The wind was loud in the grass.
I take the fish by the water.
This one isn't very fresh.
A dark fish — I have it in my teeth.
I can eat this much.
I bury this fish under the soil.
There's something dark on the ground.
Yours is on the dry earth.
This cannot be eaten.
I carried it two steps.
I scrape soil over it.
Your scent drifted over.
Your prints have trampled the dry grass.
I drop to the grass roots.
Standing in the sun makes you obvious.
There's no cover on this grassland.
Under the black fur, my claws show.
I can handle this alone.
You carry a tang of iron.
I'm upwind of you.
Leave and I won't move.
You're alone in this field.

lines.zh: 黑色的毛皮，雨里也不显。
lines.en: Black fur hides me in rain.
I follow through the grass.
You've reached the water hole.

lines.zh: 我的黑毛和影子混在一起。
lines.en: My black fur blends into the shadow.
The grass blocks your view.
You headed for the brush.
No hurry. Night suits me better.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声在草里很清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing carries clearly through the grass.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在干土上很清楚。
lines.en: Your prints show clearly in the dry soil.
Black Gabumon's horn is angled with the wind.
A bit further and there's brush.
I step on the dry grass without a sound.
The grass behind you keeps moving.
I bring a claw down.
My black fur wraps an old hide.
That tore you open.
Nobody saw me swing.

lines.zh: 我一爪下去，撞了一下就退。
lines.en: One claw stroke, one shove, and I withdraw.
We turned the dry grass over.

lines.zh: 我披着黑毛皮，走路很轻。
lines.en: Wrapped in black fur, I step lightly.
Blood on the dry earth.
I shook my claw.
I was behind you a moment ago.
You didn't hear me come.
That had some force in it.
I stood up out of the grass.
There are grass seeds on me.
The sun is fierce here.
I looked toward the water hole.
First I crouched low.
Dry grass all around.

lines.zh: 活物的味道，从林子那边来。
lines.en: Living smell, from beyond the trees.
This black coat doesn't stand out.
I rise, pressing the grass stems down.
I'm looking for good cover.
There's smoke on the wind.
I know that kind of noise.

lines.zh: 黑毛一烧，几乎看不出来。
lines.en: Burnt black fur barely shows.
I caught myself on landing.
Wet fur drags me under.
The blast pushed me far.
An arrow in my shoulder.
That light is too bright in the dark.

lines.zh: 草原上的活儿很费力气。
lines.en: Life on the savanna costs strength.
The lightning burned as far as my horn tip.
In the void, black fur is no use.
